_about: Which PRs get which review layers (ways-of-work-lean-pass D5/D7). reviewScope 'security-paths-only' matches this repo's operating posture (2026-08-10): the deterministic gate is the gate, and the judgment layers — the fresh pr-reviewer subagent + one external general pass — run on money/auth PRs only. securityPaths ALSO decides the lean external security lens. NOTE: cross-review.mjs is run from THIS checkout for the two app repos too (`--repo`), so their money/auth paths are listed here as well; they are distinct from this repo's own paths and cannot collide.
